label: The sample proportion: p-hat equals k over n, where k is the number of observations in a category and n is the total number of observations
The arithmetic mean: x-bar equals one over n times the sum of the n observations

The median by R-7 linear interpolation: h equals (n minus 1) over 2; j is the floor of h; the median is the (j plus 1)-th order statistic plus (h minus j) times the difference between the (j plus 2)-th and (j plus 1)-th order statistics
The sample standard deviation: s equals the square root of the sum of squared deviations from the mean, divided by n minus 1
The range: the maximum value minus the minimum value
